translations.web: Again Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”
translations.bsb: Again the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He stirred up David against them, saying, “Go and take a census of Israel and Judah.”
translations.kjv: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.
